verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a code-first Python framework, and Pipecat Cloud publishes a full OpenAPI 3.0 REST API. Its private API manages agents, secrets, builds, regions and organization settings, its public API starts sessions, and an official CLI covers deploys. That is a broad programmatic surface, but no evidence documents explicit parity with the Cloud dashboard UI. missing for 10: explicit documented API/UI parity statement, evidence that every dashboard action (e.g. logs, billing, session monitoring) is exposed via the API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
